recipes.label: Approaching The Spider's Door with Forge's Power
recipes.startdescription: In dreams, the Silken Sands shimmer with unbearable heat. I know the words that can channel this force, so the Sands will grant me passage -
recipes.description: The Sands glow and flow like molten glass, revealing beneath the ancient anvil of creation. Ahead, the Door pulses with an incandescent rhythm, the tempo of the smith's hammer.

recipes.label: The Glowing Sands: Not Enough!
recipes.startdescription: In dreams, the Silken Sands glow with intense heat. I know the words that control this power -
recipes.description: The Sands burn and blister my feet. The heat drains my vitality... I must gain more knowledge to endure this trial. For now, I recede into safer dreams.

recipes.label: Approaching The Spider's Door with Moth's Flight
recipes.startdescription: In dreams, the Silken Sands shimmer with a restless dance. I know the words that mirror this fluttering, so the Sands will let me pass -
recipes.description: The Sands scatter to reveal the cocoon of transformation. Ahead, the Door trembles with soft vibrations, a song that can be felt, but not heard.

recipes.label: The Dancing Sands: Not Enough!
recipes.startdescription: In dreams, the Silken Sands are the dance floor of whispers. I know the words that summon this dance -
recipes.description: The Sands shift and move under my feet, refusing to provide solid ground... I need more wisdom to join their dance. I retreat to other dreams for now.
